acip: YI DVAGS KYIS CHU KLUNG LA BLTAS PA NA RNAG KHRAG MTHONG BA DE YANG YI DVAGS 'GA' ZHIG LA YIN GYI, YI DVAGS THAMS CAD LA MA YIN TE, YI DVAGS LA PHYI'I SGRIB PA CAN, NANG GI SGRIB PA CAN, ZAS SKOM NYID LA YOD PA'I SGRIB PA CAN DU MA YOD PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: yi dvags kyis chu klung la bltas pa na rnag khrag mthong ba de yang yi dvags 'ga' zhig la yin gyi, yi dvags thams cad la ma yin te, yi dvags la phyi'i sgrib pa can, nang gi sgrib pa can, zas skom nyid la yod pa'i sgrib pa can du ma yod pa'i phyir
english: When we say that a craving spirit looks at a stream of water and sees pus and blood, by the way, we are only talking about some kinds of craving spirits, and not all of them. This is because there are many kinds of craving spirits: some with obstacles in the world around them that prevent them from relieving their craving; some with obstacles that are parts of their bodies; and some with obstacles that relate to the food or drink itself.
